construction.proof:
Exact whole-prism axial subdivision and retained-prefix return

Let a complete parent prism be B times[-H/2,H/2], in center c and
proper frame R, where H=k*h and k is2 or3. For j=0,...,k-1 define
delta_j=(j-(k-1)/2)*h. Then the k whole target prisms with the same
base B, height h, frame R and centers c+delta_j*R*e_z have disjoint
interiors and their union is the parent. This is an exact physical
subdivision. All full target owners are present; there is no fractional
owner and no new outer end cost. Their pairwise and wall compatibility
is inherited simultaneously from the complete parent packing.

For robust native coordinates, use lambda=10000001/10000000. Scale
the ideal child centers by lambda while retaining target unit shape
and frame. Each target child lies strictly inside the homothetic
lambda-parent: transverse sections are B inside lambda*B, and its
axial extreme is lambda*|delta_j|+h/2 <=lambda*H/2-(lambda-1)*h/2.
The homothetic complete parent packing remains disjoint in a host
scaled by lambda. The implementation recomputes every actual rounded
child center as an exact binary rational, transforms it back through
the exact native quaternion, and checks all its canonical vertices
against every lambda-parent face in the common exact number field.
It also checks adjacent children using the same actual axial separator.
Thus rounding is covered by actual containment, not an assumed epsilon.

Parents are ordered as in the SHA-bound native witness. For each parent
order children by j. The complete child map and full native child array
are retained. Keep a declared prefix for a smaller target count; this
deletes whole children without moving any other child. Source authors,
source frames and the full parent proof remain embedded. The final
independent native checker verifies all target owners and target host
walls directly. No angle or center optimization occurs in this transfer.

PENTAGON DOUBLE-LATTICE MARKED RETURN
15 October 2026

Source reading: Kallus and Kusner, arXiv:1509.02241, sections 2.2, 2.3, 3.1,
https://arxiv.org/html/1509.02241 . The infinite construction is attributed
to Greg Kuperberg and Wlodzimierz Kuperberg (1990); the explicit coordinates
are reconstructed from Kallus and Kusner. No source optimality is claimed as
new, and no plane-optimality assertion is needed for the finite witnesses.

Use native unit-edge pentagon vertices k0,...,k4 counterclockwise from the
positive x axis. Let p1=k0, p4=(k2+k3)/2, p2=(k0+3k1)/4, p6=(3k4+k0)/4.
The two return generators are b0=p1-p4 and b1=2(p2-p6). The latter is the
composition of two actual point reflections through p2,p6; the former is
twice a chord of the inscribed half-length parallelogram. A source word
(i,j,t) realizes B(i,j)+m_t+R_t K, where m0=0,m1=2p2 and R0=I,R1=-I.

The exact canonical quartic field verifies every one of the 34 nontrivial
ordered motif/short-word comparisons, using support of R_a K-R_b K rather
than an assumed central symmetry. For every omitted word some |zi|>=2;
the corresponding center coordinate exceeds 2R because 2Bii-mi>2R and every
base vertex has coordinate absolute value at most R. This is a complete
periodic proof, not an empirical neighborhood check. Source_control retains
all axes, supports, short words, tail slacks, and the four marked points.

Extrude over the full height [-L/2,L/2] and add period (0,0,L). Equal vertical
indices inherit the proved planar separator; different indices separate on
z. The second frame is the proper spatial halfturn diag(-1,-1,1), with the
exact native quaternion (0,0,0,1). Thus no owner is reflected improperly.

Finite operation: cut complete owners around an actual source boundary mark,
including p2,p6 with their native vertex indices and barycentric weights.
For each target count preserve the full source word, motif label, initial
center and host scale. At every continuation step select a separator that
already separates the preceding whole-owner pair; restore all host walls
simultaneously in one common linear system. Keep the resulting full centers,
all pair indices, every predecessor and fixed motif frame. A failed solver
is retained as a complete predecessor, not treated as an obstruction.

The published source receives a common 1.000001 dilation before numerical
realization. Native witnesses scale final centers by 1.0000001 and use the
same host factor plus 1e-7. Every native whole-owner pair and host wall is
then checked by the official exact-input verifier. Finite gains are compared
against both the full pinned public tree including community files and the
strongest retained own witness. Source density alone does not establish a
finite gain; all counts pay their actual boundary costs.
